تنتقوا (form VIII)
# تَنْتَقُوا (tantaqū) /tan.ta.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَى (intaqā)
# تُنْتَقَوْا (tuntaqaw) /tun.ta.qaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَى (intaqā)
